title: spiking-aeon: Neuromorphic SNN Hardware Bridge UTAC Model — GenesisAeon Package 26
description: UTAC simulation bridging the GenesisAeon CREP framework to Intel Loihi 2 neuromorphic hardware. Maps CREP {C,R,E,P} to LIF parameters (tau_m, synaptic weights, stochastic resonance noise, tau_ref). Gamma ~= 0.150 (eta=0.32). Pure-Python Brian2-compatible simulation; Lava SDK for real hardware. Calibrated: NeuEdge 2026 — 847 GOp/s/W, 2.3 ms latency, 89% core utilisation. GenesisAeon Entropy Atlas Package 26.
